definitions.explanation: Metal tools, fittings, and household implements. Includes items such as nails, hinges, knives, pots, and other metal goods.

examples.japanese: {金物|かなもの}{屋|や}でネジを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought screws at the hardware store.

examples.japanese: {建築|けんちく}に{使|つか}う{金物|かなもの}を{揃|そろ}える。
examples.english: Gather the metal fittings needed for construction.

examples.japanese: この{町|まち}は{昔|むかし}から{金物|かなもの}の{産地|さんち}として{知|し}られ、{包丁|ほうちょう}やハサミの{製造|せいぞう}が{盛|さか}んだ。
examples.english: This town has been known as a center of metalwork since long ago, with thriving production of knives and scissors.

notes:
A general term for metal goods, tools, and fittings. The {金物|かなもの}{屋|や} (hardware store) is a traditional type of shop in Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {金物|かなもの}{屋|や} (hardware store)
- {金物|かなもの}{店|てん} (hardware shop)
- {建築|けんちく}{金物|かなもの} (construction hardware)
- {金物|かなもの}の{産地|さんち} (metalwork production area)

Famous {金物|かなもの} production areas in Japan include {三木|みき} (Miki, Hyogo) for tools and {燕三条|つばめさんじょう} (Tsubame-Sanjo, Niigata) for cutlery and kitchen items.
